project_identity.name: CloudIVR + SIP / Speechcue (Nomadly Brand)
project_identity.context: Telephony SaaS Dashboard & Marketing Landing Platform
project_identity.theme: Dark Mode First (Obsidian Slate with Neon Electric Accents) with Light Mode Toggle Support
project_identity.target_audience: Global businesses, remote teams, marketers, call centers, and crypto-native users requiring cloud virtual numbers, IVR workflows, SMS forwarding, and WebRTC softphone.

hierarchy.h1_hero: text-4xl sm:text-5xl lg:text-6xl font-extrabold tracking-tight leading-none

colors.contrast_rules: Maintain minimum 4.5:1 ratio for body text, 3:1 for large text and interactive elements. Avoid full transparent backgrounds on dropdowns and floating headers.

glassmorphism.use_case: Sticky header navigation, floating softphone dock, floating modal overlays

tracing_borders.use_case: High-conversion pricing plans, active campaign progress indicators, live call cards
tracing_borders.style: 1px solid stroke with subtle emerald/sky glow shadow

neumorphism_tactile.use_case: WebRTC Dialpad key buttons, audio playback toggle controls

dashboard_density.mode: MODE B: HIGH DENSITY DATA GRID
dashboard_density.rule: Every widget uses flex/h-full stretching to avoid jagged bottoms. Densified cards with 1px border

navigation_header.rule: Visible desktop navigation with Logo, 4 key links (My Numbers, IVR Builder, Campaigns, Softphone, Wallet), Status Badge, and Primary Action CTA. Background must have crystal glass blur.

buy_number_wizard.ui_pattern: Horizontal step progress bar with numeric badge indicators and real-time wallet deduction feedback

features: Greeting Audio/TTS picker with AI Voice & Speed controls
Interactive Action Tree (Press 1/2/3 -> Forward / Voicemail / Sub-menu)
visual_ivr_builder.ui_pattern: Interactive tree canvas / node connector blocks with high contrast action states

features: Mute, Hold, Audio output toggle, Hangup buttons
Crypto Coin Selector (BTC, ETH, USDT, SOL)
Instant Balance Meter & Transaction History Table

image_urls.description: Call center customer support agent in modern workplace with headset
Support team members handling live phone lines
Graphical user interface showing crypto currencies and wallet network
Close-up of Bitcoin coin on modern laptop keyboard symbolizing instant wallet top-up

icons.rules: Never use emoji characters for technical icons. Use Lucide or Phosphor icons exclusively.

accessibility_and_testing.data_testid_rule: ALL interactive buttons, inputs, tabs, modals, tables, and numeric meters MUST contain kebab-case data-testid attributes.
accessibility_and_testing.keyboard_nav: Full tab index support, visible focus rings with `focus:ring-2 focus:ring-emerald-400 focus:outline-none`
accessibility_and_testing.reduced_motion: Respect `prefers-reduced-motion`media queries for scroll animations and WebRTC audio waveform pulsing.

instructions_to_main_agent: Ensure Nomadly CloudIVR + SIP / Speechcue branding is consistently emphasized.
Implement WebRTC Softphone floating dock with dialpad and incoming call handler simulation.

Support full feature parity: Landing Page, Login/Signup, Numbers Management with detail tabs (Overview, Forwarding, Voicemail, SMS, SIP, Recording, IVR, Logs, Billing), Buy Number Wizard, Visual IVR Builder, Quick IVR Call, Bulk Campaigns, Audio Library, Call/SMS logs, and Crypto Wallet.
Ensure dark mode is default with rich contrast tokens, glassmorphism headers, and emerald/cyan primary accents.
Add data-testid attributes on every form field, action button, tab item, and data cell for automated testing.
